name: Local Downloads

needles: This title was already downloaded from a different source.
This title was already downloaded from the same source.

focusedTests: LocalDownloadsRuntimeTest source long-press, same-source, different-source, overwrite, episode-identity and source-key cases; LocalDownloadsSegmentedTest, SegmentedMediaTest, LocalMediaRuntimeTest and generic storage write-capability tests
isolated application on all declared APK assets
combined application with Local Media and every current optional patch
TV AVD real transfer of a small direct progressive source for a series episode
acceptance: Settings > Morphe > Playback shows Allow local downloads above Show local storage in Library when both patches are installed

Local Downloads and autoplay default on for fresh preferences; the native Maximum usable selected storage slider defaults to 80%, with positions 1, 5, 10 through 100, and stored choices remain authoritative

Startup and toggle changes never request storage; the first Download action requests access only when needed, denial leaves Downloads on with a retryable Storage access required message, and one grant is usable by Local Media
One unsectioned Local storage path row remains at the bottom whenever Local Downloads or Local Media is installed and is greyed and unfocusable only while both features are off
Local Downloads applies and runs without Local Media, and Local Media applies and runs without Local Downloads
Every title options dialog that contains Play manually, including resumed episodes with Start from beginning, also contains Download to storage while enabled
For the exact movie or episode currently downloading, every Download to storage action becomes Download in progress... and restores the hidden progress popup without starting another transfer
Selecting Download to storage opens Nuvio's existing manual source picker and consumes the resolved source without starting playback

Holding a source in either picker opens Play and Download; short press remains Play in an ordinary picker and Download in an explicit download picker, and a held-source choice overrides only that source

Downloading an already indexed logical movie or exact series episode from the same source shows the same-source message with only Back; a different source shows the different-source message with Download and overwrite and Back
Download and overwrite removes the prior indexed movie or exact episode and its patch-owned files before resolving the selected replacement source; adjacent episodes are never treated as duplicates
Download mode remains active for every source selected in the same picker session and clears only after leaving that picker
Torrent, YouTube, HLS and DASH sources are rejected with a clear direct-source message
A source larger than the configured percentage of currently free storage is rejected before transfer, with smaller-source guidance
FAT32 and filesystem-unknown removable/document storage use a rolling 3,750,000,000-byte writer and expose every conservatively stored download as one seekable logical file

FAT32 transfers use the same movie-title or Show - Season N folder as ordinary downloads; a one-part result collapses to the original video file when storage supports a safe move, while multi-part results replace that file with one descriptive short-ID bundle folder
Settings > Downloads counts, plays and deletes a segmented download as one item while removing every physical segment, manifest and indexed subtitle and pruning empty bundle and logical folders

The progress popup reports bytes and percentage, identifies episodes as Title · SnnEnn, keeps movie titles unchanged, allows Hide to keep the foreground transfer running, and removes the partial file on Cancel
Cancel disconnects a source check that is still blocked and returns from Cancelling without waiting for the network timeout
Settings and progress both show one-decimal used/total GB for the volume containing Local storage path, followed by parenthesized percent full
The TV-native D-pad folder picker lists mounted internal, SD-card and USB volumes through Android StorageManager and persists the selected volume across relaunches
While Local Downloads is enabled, raw paths pass a real create/delete probe and SAF paths include a persisted write grant before selection is saved; Local Media alone remains read-only capable
Every Download action revalidates a saved path and reopens write-capable folder selection after permission revocation, a read-only remount or folder removal before resolving a source
If selected removable storage is disconnected, usage is reported unavailable and downloads fail with reconnection guidance instead of silently using internal storage
A hidden successful download reopens the completion popup unless full-screen playback is active
Movies use a sanitized title folder; series episodes use a sanitized Title - Season n folder; addon subtitle sidecars share the video basename
Only addon subtitles matching Nuvio's preferred primary or secondary subtitle language are downloaded
Play local file appears for an exact downloaded title or episode and routes through Nuvio's player with catalogue identity preserved
Delete local file removes the exact downloaded video and indexed subtitle sidecars, removes the folder only when empty, and immediately removes its episode badge

Downloads lists only indexed Nuvio downloads with separated rows and a visible TV focus cursor; pressing an entry plays it, holding it opens Play and Delete actions, and Delete all downloads never removes manually copied files
Downloaded episodes use Nuvio's exact episode-card statusBadgeSize, statusIconSize and statusBadgeInset at the top-right, geometrically mirroring the watched tick at the top-left
Enabled movie detail pages show the arrow-down action immediately right of Watched using the same native spacing, selected colours and D-pad focus enlargement
The movie detail action opens a one-Back popup whose undownloaded state enters the existing source picker and whose downloaded state offers Play local file and Delete local file
Movie detail and Play long-press resolve downloaded movies by stable catalogue content id even when the selected source video id differs
Autoplay local storage when available replaces only an exact normal-play route and never changes manual source selection
Local Media recognizes both exact and language-tagged subtitle sidecars without depending on Local Downloads
Embedded subtitles and indexed external subtitle sidecars remain available when playback uses the segmented virtual URI, without duplicate sidecar attachment
No source URL or HTTP header is persisted after a download completes
No crash, ANR, VerifyError, leaked partial file or fatal log occurs during download, hide, cancel, completion or local playback
